entities.summary: George Earl "Trey" Kell III is an American-Syrian professional basketball player for the Toyama Grouses of the Japanese B.League. He has previously played in Canada, Bosnia, Poland and Hong Kong. He played college basketball for the San Diego State Aztecs.
